turns.question: Under the current handbook, how many annual leave days does a full-time employee receive?
turns.reference_answer: From 1 January 2026, a full-time employee receives 24 annual leave days per calendar year.

turns.question: What is the current annual leave carryover limit?
turns.reference_answer: From 2026, an employee may carry up to 8 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

turns.question: How did annual leave and carryover change between the 2024 and 2026 employee handbooks?
turns.reference_answer: Annual leave increased from 20 to 24 days per year, and the carryover limit increased from 5 to 8 unused days.

turns.question: How soon must an employee submit a new business expense under the current policy?
turns.reference_answer: A new business expense must be submitted within 30 calendar days of purchase.

turns.question: How many days per month must a remote-designated employee normally work from a Northstar office?
turns.reference_answer: A remote-designated employee normally works from a Northstar office at least 3 days per calendar month.

turns.question: What is the annual limit for working remotely outside an employee's employing country?
turns.reference_answer: Cross-border remote work is limited to 45 calendar days per year and requires prior People Operations approval.

turns.question: Compare the additional days provided to employees assigned to the Kyiv and Berlin hubs.
turns.reference_answer: Kyiv employees receive 4 recovery days per year, while Berlin employees receive 2 civic-service days per year. Neither benefit carries over.

turns.question: How much fully paid family leave do primary and secondary caregivers receive?
turns.reference_answer: A primary caregiver receives 18 weeks of fully paid leave, and a secondary caregiver receives 8 weeks.

turns.question: What temporary schedule is available immediately after family leave?
turns.reference_answer: An employee may work an 80 percent schedule at full base pay for 4 weeks after family leave, subject to agreement with the manager.

turns.question: How much annual leave do full-time employees receive now?
turns.reference_answer: From 1 January 2026, full-time employees receive 24 annual leave days per calendar year.

turns.question: And how many of those can I carry into the next year?
turns.reference_answer: An employee may carry up to 8 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.
